tasks.prompt: Fix incrementing prereleases when the requested identifier contains dots. inc(3.0.0-alpha.beta.5.4, prerelease, false, alpha.beta) should continue to 3.0.0-alpha.beta.5.5 rather than restart the sequence. A matching prefix followed by a nonnumeric segment must restart, and a mismatching prefix must be replaced. Preserve identifierBase options, invalid-identifier handling, single-component identifiers, and nonmutation of SemVer objects passed to the public inc function. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix picomatch so a pattern whose last element is a globstar inside a group, such as test(/utils/**) or test?(/utils/**), matches the parent path test/utils as well as paths below it. Keep the group semantics: a required group must not match the bare prefix, an optional group still may, strictSlashes still rejects a bare parent, and anything following the group still has to match. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix picomatch so that ** immediately followed by a literal in the same path segment, such as **.thing.js, behaves like a single * and cannot match across path separators: somepath/test.thing.js must not match **.thing.js, while test.thing.js still does. Do not change how **/ forms or bare ** segments behave. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix picomatch bracket negation: a leading ! (or ^) inside a bracket class such as [!abc] must negate the class, so isMatch("a", "[!abc]") is false and isMatch("d", "[!abc]") is true, with and without the posix option. Preserve escaped \!, a non-leading ! as a literal, [!]] negating a closing bracket, an unterminated [!] staying literal, and the literalBrackets / nobracket options. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix picomatch so a globstar (**) matches paths that contain newline or carriage-return characters, e.g. isMatch("hello\nworld", "**") should be true. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix bytes formatting with the thousandsSeparator option: the separator must only group the integer part of the number. bytes(1234567.891234, {unit: "B", decimalPlaces: 6, thousandsSeparator: ","}) should give "1,234,567.891234B", not insert separators into the digits after the decimal point. Preserve grouping of the integer part (including negative numbers), fixedDecimals, decimalPlaces, unitSeparator, unit selection, a plain format with no thousandsSeparator, and parsing. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix the cookie package so serialize() accepts a Domain option with a single leading dot, as browsers and RFC 6265 allow: serialize("foo", "bar", { domain: ".example.com" }) should return "foo=bar; Domain=.example.com" instead of throwing. Preserve validation of everything else: a domain still must be made of valid labels (letters, digits, hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphen, at most 63 characters each) separated by single dots, and must still be rejected if it has a trailing dot, consecutive dots, more than one leading dot, spaces or other invalid characters. Domains without a leading dot, and the validation of other options, must behave as before. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix the path-to-regexp 0.1.x package so that route patterns with several parameters or a wildcard in one segment separated by literals build correct lookaheads. pathToRegexp("/:a-:b-:c").exec("/1-2-3--4") currently matches and returns c = "-4": the generated regex keeps accumulating earlier separators ((?!\/|-), then (?!\/|--), then (?!\/|---)) instead of using only the literal text since the previous parameter. After the fix "/:a-:b-:c" must not match "/1-2-3--4", "/:a-:b-:c-:d" must not match "/1-2-3-4---5", and "/a*-:b-:c" must not match "/ab-1-2--3". Preserve: "/:a-:b-:c" still matches "/1-2-3" with captures 1,2,3, "/:a/:b" and "/:a-:b" behave as before, and a param still never matches across a slash. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Reject invalid strict version ranges that put a numeric component after a wildcard component. For example, validRange("1.x.5"), validRange("x.1"), and validRange("1.x.5 || 2.x") should return null, while ordinary trailing-wildcard ranges remain valid. Preserve valid ranges, comparator behavior, and existing loose parsing semantics. Do not special-case only these examples. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Make exact zero-major caret ranges consistent with exact nonzero-major caret ranges when includePrerelease is enabled. satisfies("0.0.3-alpha", "^0.0.3", {includePrerelease:true}) and the equivalent ^0.2.3 case should be false: the exact release lower bound must not admit its earlier prereleases. Preserve explicit prerelease bounds, partial/wildcard caret ranges, and ordinary caret upper bounds. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix diff() classification when transitioning from a prerelease to a stable version with a different core version. diff("1.7.2-1", "1.8.1") should report "minor", and diff("1.1.1-pre", "2.1.1") should report "major", rather than deciding from whether the target has a nonzero patch. The result must remain symmetric. Preserve prerelease-to-prerelease classification and existing stabilization semantics: releasing 1.2.0-pre as 1.2.0 is minor, releasing 1.2.3-pre as 1.2.3 is patch, and stabilizing a prerelease whose minor and patch are both zero is major. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Fix handling of prerelease identifiers that begin with digits but also contain letters. In particular, coerce("1.0.0-1a", {includePrerelease:true}) must retain the complete identifier 1a rather than truncate it to 1. Preserve full mixed prerelease/build information, coercion without includePrerelease, valid numeric identifiers, invalid-version rejection, and increment identifier validation. Investigate the shared parsing behavior so related public APIs remain consistent. The original upstream repository/package and its layout are under src/. No dependency installation is needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Repair mapping handling at document boundaries and in public event consumers. A missing mapping value immediately before a document-start or document-end marker must produce an implicit null value, preserving the key and subsequent documents. The public event-to-value and event-to-AST consumers must reject malformed event streams whose mapping closes with an unpaired key, rather than silently dropping it. Preserve valid mappings, sequences, empty documents, nested collections, and explicit null behavior. The original upstream repository is under src/; production TypeScript is under src/src/. Node 24 executes it directly, with no install or build needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Repair YAML AST presentation so that parsing a folded block scalar, converting events to AST, presenting it, and loading the result preserves its string value when content lines start with tabs. Cover tab-leading first, last and middle lines, long tab-leading lines, and ordinary long lines with a space followed by a tab near a possible wrap point. Preserve folded style, literal style, normal spaces and blank-line/chomping behavior. The dump API alone is not sufficient to reproduce this: exercise the public parseEvents -> eventsToAst -> present pipeline. The original upstream repository is under src/; production TypeScript is under src/src/. Node 24 executes it directly, with no install or build needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.

Restore numeric dump/load round trips for large integer-valued JavaScript numbers whose decimal representation uses exponent notation (for example 1e21, negative values, and Number.MAX_VALUE). The behavior must work under the default, Core, JSON and YAML 1.1 schemas, as scalars and inside collections. Preserve regular integers, fractions, zero and negative zero; preserve schema validation that rejects exponent notation explicitly tagged as !!int. Coordinate tag identification and emitted representation rather than loosening integer parsing to accept invalid YAML integer text. The original upstream repository is under src/; production TypeScript is under src/src/. Node 24 executes it directly, with no install or build needed. Run the public regression checks with node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Preserve original upstream tests, fixtures, documentation, and package metadata.
